answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 79 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 18 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 79 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 731 sponsors, each risking real money. The signal test is the live device, the vine test is the locked stake, and the ferrous test is the graded history no template can fake.
